# @cortex-ui/vcs-git-card-git

Git in the card: branch, ahead/behind, changes, commit, push, branch, checkpoint, restore, pull request.

- **Plugin id:** `vcs-git.card-git`
- **Slot:** `card.git@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `card.git@1` as `vcs-git.card-git`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** `agents.defaultMode`, `code.target`, `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Workbench state written:** `code.options`, `code.scope`, `pane.tab`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `browser.open`, `vcs.checkout`, `vcs.checkpoint`, `vcs.checkpoints`, `vcs.commit`, `vcs.pr.status`, `vcs.push`, `vcs.restore`, `vcs.status`
- **Topics followed:** `tools.files_changed`, `vcs.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
